headline: Aurobindo Pharma obtains FTC approval for Lannett acquisition
sum: Aurobindo Pharma has secured US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) approval for its acquisition of Lannett Company Inc., a key regulatory gate in the cross-border pharmaceutical M&A transaction.
detail: Aurobindo Pharma, India's third-largest pharmaceutical player, has been pursuing the acquisition of Lannett, a US-listed generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer. The FTC approval obtained on 19 June 2026 represents clearance of the mandatory US antitrust review under the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) Act. This is a material milestone but does not conclude all regulatory requirements; Indian foreign investment and sectoral approvals, and final NSE/BSE disclosures remain pending.
